testName: Einstein Prompt Builder Template Execution & Response Grounding
steps:
1. Open Opportunities tab and open recent Opportunity record
2. Locate Einstein Copilot / Prompt action "Generate Executive Deal Summary"
3. Click "Generate Summary" button
4. In Prompt preview, verify merge fields: {!$Record.Name}, {!$Record.Amount}, and {!$Record.CloseDate} are correctly populated
5. Verify generated response contains structured bullet points: Executive Summary, Key Stakeholders, and Next Steps
6. Verify deal Amount ($150,000) matches CRM value exactly
7. Click "Insert into Field" to commit generated text into Opportunity Description
